rejected_findings.issue: A speaker record with a non-string 'why' (e.g. a number or list) crashes the note build; the builder's contract says why is a string, but the reader otherwise tolerates junk (isinstance checks on seg/people, str() on name).
rejected_findings.fix: Wrap as _cut(str(sp["why"]), 120) — or leave it; the builder seals the record and the except clause already covers unreadable pins, so this is a nit, not a consensus defect.
